intent.proves: At least one active grid row exists on a non-deleted page.

bindings.reason: Tool is scoped to one area or page; a handler must enumerate every area/page and aggregate, which mcp-count does not do.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GridRow g JOIN Page p ON p.PageId = g.GridRowPageId WHERE g.GridRowActive = 1 AND g.GridRowDeleted = 0 AND p.PageDeleted = 0
